sessionStart.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" idle "Copilot session started" 60 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

userPromptSubmitted.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" working "Copilot is working" 3600 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

permissionRequest.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" blocked "Copilot needs permission" 3600 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

postToolUse.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" working "Copilot is working" 3600 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

agentStop.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" done "Copilot finished" 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

errorOccurred.bash: test -z "${TMUX_PANE:-}" || agentmux status "$TMUX_PANE" blocked "Copilot reported an error" 300 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
